'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Allen Gaible DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Endor Ops w/ TIEs. Header Allan in inventory.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Allen Gaible]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Establish Secret Base|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
